PM Lloyd George and Winston Churchill tried to declare war on Mustafa Kemal, but most of the dominions rejected. This was the first time they acted on their own in foreign relations and opened the way for British to lose their colonies in a few decades. This was called Chanak Crisis. Lloyd George's entire political career has ended, Churchill had to resign from his office with the fall of the government a second time because of Mustafa Kemal.
